openAtLogin.label: Open Colorpicker at login
openAtLogin.description: Launch Colorpicker automatically when you log in

keepOnTop.label: Keep Colorpicker on top
keepOnTop.description: Always display Colorpicker above other windows

closeToTray.label: Close to tray
closeToTray.description: Keep Colorpicker running in the system tray instead of quitting when the window is closed

language.label: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for Colorpicker

resetSettings.label: Reset settings to default
resetSettings.description: Restore all settings to their original default values

about.title: About
about.experimentalUnlockedToast: Experimental features unlocked — keep in mind these are subject to change

isBordered.label: Bordered window
isBordered.description: Show a border around the Colorpicker window

isFullColored.label: Full colored background
isFullColored.description: Fill the entire window with the current color instead of just the accent areas

isVibrant.label: Vibrant appearance
isVibrant.description: Use a more vibrant, saturated window style

eyedropperAdaptiveBorder.label: Adaptive picker border
eyedropperAdaptiveBorder.description: Adapt the magnifier's outer border color to the pixel underneath it (black on light, white on dark) instead of a constant white

gridSize.label: Pixel Grid Size
gridSize.description: Set the size of the pixel grid displayed in the magnifier

magnifierSize.label: Magnifier Size
magnifierSize.description: Set the diameter of the circular magnifier window

showHex.label: Show Hex Code
showHex.description: Display the hex color code in the magnifier

showPixelGrid.label: Show Pixel Grid
showPixelGrid.description: Display a semi-transparent grid between magnified pixels

hideMain.label: Hide Main Window
hideMain.description: Automatically hide the main Colorpicker window when using the magnifier

detectBackgroundChanges.label: Detect Background Changes
detectBackgroundChanges.description: Poll for color changes while the cursor is stationary, useful for picking colors from video or animations

allowHoverThrough.label: Allow Hover Through
allowHoverThrough.description: Let mouse events pass through the magnifier so you can pick hover-state colors from underlying windows

autoCopyOnPick.label: Auto-copy on pick
autoCopyOnPick.description: Automatically copy the color to the clipboard whenever you pick one

quickPickHeadless.label: Headless quick-pick
quickPickHeadless.description: Pick without ever showing the main window: copies the color and shows a notification instead

cursorAsideMode.label: Cursor-aside mode
cursorAsideMode.description: Windows only. Shows the magnifier beside your mouse pointer instead of over it, so you keep seeing your cursor while picking

defaultFormat.label: Default format
defaultFormat.description: The color format used when copying, and shown by default throughout Colorpicker

hexPrefix.label: Hex prefix
hexPrefix.description: Include the leading # when displaying or copying hex colors

pickerHotkey.label: Launch Picker Hotkey
pickerHotkey.description: Global keyboard shortcut to launch the color picker from anywhere, even when Colorpicker is closed

hotkey.noModifier: Include at least one modifier key
hotkey.reserved: This shortcut is reserved by the system
